ACCUMULATED_NARRATIVE:  
Alex’s Monday unfolded as a steady navigation through moderate demands and restrained emotional responses. Early energy and flow moments were tempered by low-quality managerial feedback and fragmented communication, which kept psychological safety and engagement from rising. Social interactions provided some reassurance but also drained energy moderately, reflecting her cautious trust in colleagues. Despite mild fatigue from poor sleep and screen overload, Alex maintained a balanced performance, drawing on her curiosity and resilience to sustain a typical, if unremarkable, workday rhythm. Her affect valence remained subdued, painting a picture of quiet perseverance rather than enthusiasm or distress.
